name: Lido
description: Lido is the largest liquid-staking protocol on Ethereum. Users stake ETH and receive stETH, a token that accrues staking rewards while remaining usable across DeFi; the validators are run by a curated set of node operators.
description_zh: Lido 是以太坊上最大的流动性质押协议。用户质押 ETH 并获得 stETH，该代币会累积质押奖励，同时可以在 DeFi 中继续使用；验证者由一组经过筛选的节点运营商运行。

geo_site.method: stake.lido.fi/api/geo answers HTTP 403 'Access to our services from your current location is unavailable' to some countries and the app shows the same warning. The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: CU, IR, SY).

geo_feature.scope: /api/geo (cf-ipcountry): full|limited; remote config geo.limited=[US] -> Earn vaults; Tor/unknown -> limited Live: /api/geo answers availability=limited from the US (2026-10-12; staking disabled, withdrawals stay), full elsewhere.

tos.restricted: Crimea, CU, DPR, IR, LPR, KP, SY + sanctioned; US/UK: Earn only

notes: The IPFS build lets you control the API base paths. Stake/Withdraw are not geo-gated.
